subject: Entry-tier swap & usage safeguard approval request — Carenet pilot
body:
--- Message 1/5 ---
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@carenet.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@carenet.ai
Date: 2027-08-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial proposal — usage tiers and credits

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the updated proposal. A couple of quick asks from procurement before we can move to internal sign-off:
- Can you make the entry tier (Pilot) include an automatic usage safeguard: 15% credit for first-month overage above committed tokens?
- We would also like the ability to swap to the next entry tier without penalty in month 2 if demand doubles.

These are important for our board to approve the pilot. If you can include these, Carenet is prepared to sign the SOW by end of next week.

Best,
Oliver
Senior Procurement Manager
Carenet HealthTech

--- Message 2/5 ---
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-18T10:03:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Pilot commercial proposal — usage tiers and credits (need VP/CFO signoff?)

Team — forwarding Carenet's asks. Two non-standard items: 1) automated first-month 15% overage credit, 2) penalty-free tier swap in month 2.

Context: Carenet is a strategic HS1 prospect (healthcare payer) — likely multi-year if pilot succeeds. The deal economics assume a small onboarding discount (20%) and VPC deployment (private). The requested overage credit and swap increase our downside on the early runway; procurement claims the board will not approve without them.

Can you weigh risks and recommend whether this should be escalated to VP/CFO for authorization? I captured numbers in the attached MAAP KPI table.

Attachments: Carenet_MAAP_KPI_Table.xlsx

Thanks,
Lauren
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--- Message 3/5 ---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-18T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot commercial proposal — usage tiers and credits (need VP/CFO signoff?)

Lauren — quick read. Summary:
- Financial impact (conservative): 15% credit on first-month overage reduces net revenue for month 1 by ~3.8% of expected pilot ARR (given our forecasted distribution).
- Swap-to-next-tier option could cause a short-term loss if they immediately expand then churn; but it materially increases probability they sign the longer-term contract.

Recommendation: escalate to VP/CFO as a conditional exception: approve the 15% first-month credit capped at $25k and allow one-time tier swap within first 60 days only if they meet agreed throughput metrics.

I can draft the exception memo if you want — will include precedent cases.

Marissa
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

--- Message 4/5 ---
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-19T09:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot commercial proposal — usage tiers and credits (need VP/CFO signoff?)

Adding finance perspective:
- Upside: approving the swap and credit raises conversion probability by our estimate of +18% (based on similar pilot precedents).
- Downside: exposure if usage spikes massively; mitigate with a hard cap and clear monitoring hooks in the contract (daily token caps and auto-notify).

Suggested approval language for VP/CFO: "Approve limited commercial exception for Carenet CRN-2027-741: one-time 15% credit applied to first-month overage (capped at $25,000) and a single tier-up switch within 60 days at no early-termination penalty, contingent on passing thresholds in the attached MAAP KPI table and usage alerts enabled. Exception expires if legal edits add any residual liability."

If you want, Marissa — please finalize memo. If acceptable, I'll route to CFO (Markus) and VP Revenue (Vivek) for signature.

Kimberly
Head of Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference

--- Message 5/5 ---
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-19T15:40:00Z
Subject: Executive approval request — commercial exception for Carenet (CRN-2027-741)

Markus / Vivek —

As discussed below, request your quick review and sign-off on a limited commercial exception for Carenet HealthTech (deal CRN-2027-741). Key points: 
• Customer: Carenet HealthTech (payer-focused SaaS) — pilot is VPC, expected to convert to 12–24 month contract.
• Ask: one-time 15% credit on first-month overage (capped at $25k) + one penalty-free tier-up within 60 days if throughput increases.
• Rationale: reduces procurement friction, materially increases conversion probability with modest near-term revenue exposure.
• Safeguards: daily cap alerts, MAAP KPI pass/fail gating, legal to include explicit cap and auto-notify clause (no open-ended credits).
• Attachments: Carenet_Offer_Sheet_v3.pdf (offer with tracked changes), Carenet_MAAP_KPI_Table.xlsx (thresholds). HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CRN-2027-741

Marissa drafted the exception memo below for your signature. Please respond with "Approve" or "Decline / edits"; if approved, Kim will route the signed exception into the contract packet and instruct Legal to finalize the SOW. Time sensitive — procurement expects a signed SOW by 2027-08-26.

-- Forwarded exception memo (draft) --
Subject: Exception memo — limited credit & tier-swap approval (Carenet CRN-2027-741)
Requested by: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Summary: Approve limited commercial exception that includes a one-time 15% credit applied to first-month overage (capped at $25,000) and a single penalty-free tier-up within 60 days, subject to the MAAP KPI thresholds listed in the attached table.
Risk & Mitigations: See attached financial analysis (spreadsheet).
Recommendation: Approve with signatures from CFO and VP Revenue.

Thanks for the quick look —
Lauren Bishop
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

--- End of thread ---
